topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I couldn't help but pace back and forth as I held the phone, the room spinning a bit. I stared at the messages, each one a piece of a puzzle that no longer fit. Plans had been in motion for weeks, every detail meticulously arranged. The cake, the streamers, the playlist—everything was set. And now, with just a few taps, it all came apart. I checked the time, my fingers fidgeting with the edge of my shirt. They said they’d let me know, but I couldn’t shake the sense that something was off. Maybe it was just a delay, a minor setback. But deep down, the silence was deafening.
